title: 个性化多模态大语言模型代理：基于长期用户交互的记忆增强框架
summary: 提出POLAR框架，通过多模态知识图谱记忆（语义记忆+情景记忆）增强具身MLLM代理的个性化能力，使其能利用长期交互中的隐式上下文执行任务。实验表明该机制在跨交互推理、多跳推理和用户上下文追踪等场景下显著提升性能。
summary_en: Proposes POLAR, a multimodal memory-augmented framework for personalized embodied MLLM agents. It organizes prior interactions into a knowledge graph capturing semantic and episodic memory, enabling agents to leverage long-term user context for task execution. Consistently improves performance, especially in multi-interaction reasoning and user-specific context tracking.
